notes.title: Possible Delay of the Steam Version Release
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for your continued support of SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim.

In regard to the Steam release of SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim, the final review by Valve is taking longer than expected, and there is a possibility that the release may be delayed beyond the originally scheduled date of May 29th.

Although the build was submitted with sufficient lead time, the review process is taking longer than expected due to checks related to certain in-game expressions.
We are in active communication with Valve and working hard to resolve the issue as quickly as possible. We sincerely apologize for any concern or inconvenience caused to our Steam users.

Please note that the same version of the game is already available on DLsite and Stove.

We will provide an update as soon as there are any changes regarding the Steam release.
Thank you very much for your continued support.

notes.title: Release Date for SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim Set for Thursday, May 29, 2025!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]◤　SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim Launches May 29, 2025! 
　 An Adventure Game About a giant Girl and little People.　◢[/b][/h3]

We are pleased to announce that SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim, an adventure game about little people shrunk to the size of a thumb and the giant girl Saeko, will officially launch on Thursday, May 29, 2025.

　　　　　　　　　　　　⇩⇩⇩Watch the release date teaser here.⇩⇩⇩
[previewyoutube=hEvulgUjj7g;full][/previewyoutube]
You’ve been shrunk down to the size of a thumb—how many more days can you survive in Saeko’s world?
And when you find yourself in a position to sway their destinies, who will you choose to save?

We hope you look forward to experiencing the fate of Saeko and the little people in this cruel yet captivating story with avant-garde art!
